method.candidateScreen: All 251 source camera positions screened against 77 CAD-identified garage anchors. Existing assignments plus approaches under 28 m, at least 1 m in front of the garage front plane and less than 73 degrees oblique; all other approaches under 18 m were also checked for corner/side exceptions.
method.visualReview: 200 Cloudflare preview images rectilinearly projected toward each of 522 candidate garage/pano pairs. Add only when a recognisable parking opening and usable garage paving are adequately visible. Reject walls, foreground foliage, substantial occlusion, very narrow side slivers, and distant ambiguous views. Existing placements preserved unchanged.
method.placement: Recalculate local yaw and pitch separately using each pano source heading and camera position. Image-space refinements avoid foreground planting/vehicles where a usable patch of parking paving is visible. These are visually calibrated UI markers, not survey-grade placement.
method.runtime: Explicit reviewed whitelist in data/exterior-villa-hotspots.json. Each active pano may contain several different villas. Runtime does not guess visibility from distance and does not load all 218 markers at once.
method.preservation: SHA-256 uses JSON.stringify(pointer) in the original field order, recording all 78 pre-existing pointer objects without changing their ID, position, style, or destination.
